notes: Public Health Seattle and King County's food plan review questionnaire. Part A's requirement boxes take an X when the applicant acknowledges them. Part B and C questions are NA, Yes or No as printed (an answer of No needs an explanation sent with the plans; this PDF has no box for it). Question 25 takes every food handling step that applies, by name. The finish schedule takes one answer per area: 'floors, coving, walls, ceiling, counters'.

q25_steps.check: Packaged food only no open food such as grocery store#1
Cold holding food in refrigerators and at 41F or below#1
Assemble portion or mix food making sandwiches drinks etc#1
Reheat to serve immediately reheat food to order using turbo chef microwave etc no hot holding#1
Produce rinsing produce must be washed prior to cuttingserving unless commercially prewashed#1
Serve without cooking such as in drinks and dressing#1
Hot holding keep the food hot during operation at 135F or above#1
Cooling save hot leftovers cook hot food in advance and cool it rapidly for later use#1
Time as a public health control food held at room temperature up to 4 hours then discarded#1
